Class FollowController

java.lang.Object
arkheim.server.infrastructure.api.controllers.FollowController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/follows") public class FollowController extends Object
Controller for user follow relationship operations (following, unfollowing, follow status checks, and lists).

      Parameters:

      ResponseEntity containing a boolean (true if following, false otherwise)
